outcome: maternal and fetal outcomes of viral hepatitis
cohort: 130 pregnant women with hepatitis infection at Narayana Medical College and Hospital in Sasaran, Bihar, India, over a five-year period from October 2017 to November 2022.
finding: Out of 13,385 pregnancies, 0.97% (130) were complicated by hepatitis infection, most commonly hepatitis E (84.61%), with the majority of cases occurring in primigravida women (56.1%) during the first trimester.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was performed in 74 (56.92%) cases due to prolonged pervaginal leaking and fetal distress.
